description: This file defines the ThemeDao class which provides data access methods for Theme entities within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes functions to save, retrieve, and delete themes, as well as fetching partial theme data and theme images based on specific keys and names.

classes.name: ThemeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Theme entity, providing CRUD operations and specialized queries related to themes.

methods.name: saveTheme
methods.description: Persists a Theme entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getThemeByThemeName
methods.description: Retrieves a Theme by its name, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getPartialThemeByThemeName
methods.description: Fetches a partial view of a Theme as a PartialTheme DTO based on theme name.

methods.name: deleteThemeByThemeName
methods.description: Deletes a Theme identified by its name, returning the number of affected records.

methods.name: getImageByImageKeyAndThemeName
methods.description: Retrieves a ThemeImage DTO for the specified image key and theme name, if available and not empty.
